title: Requesting annual holidays and what the employer must do
version: Employment New Zealand pages 'Annual holidays' (no last-modified date shown), 'Taking annual holidays' (last modified 7 September 2026), 'Managing annual holidays' (last modified 11 November 2025), 'Annual closedowns and holidays' (last modified 7 August 2026), 'Cashing-up annual holidays' (last modified 7 August 2026) and 'Annual holiday pay' (last modified 7 August 2026), all read 19 Nov 2026
sourceNote: Six pages from Employment New Zealand, the NZ Government's official employment site. Annual holidays: a short landing page (4 weeks after 12 months of continuous employment). Taking annual holidays (for employees): entitlement, working out a week, being paid before the holiday, when you can take holidays, when the employer can require them (14 days' notice, regular closedown), unexpected closures, cancelling, and leaving a job. Managing annual holidays (for employers): what the employer must and cannot do, approving and declining requests, holidays in advance, requiring holidays, unexpected closedowns, cancelling, and paying out when employment ends. Annual closedowns and holidays: what a closedown is, staff with and without enough holidays (8% payment, moving the anniversary date), other leave and public holidays during a closedown, other closedowns. Cashing-up annual holidays: asking in writing, how the employer must respond, workplace policies, no pressure, paying out, the 1-week limit. Annual holiday pay: only the greater of ordinary weekly pay and average weekly earnings, and when to pay. The site blocks direct download here and no browser was available, so every line was read by a fetch tool asked to quote exact sentences; key lines were confirmed exact in a second read, but small slips in commas and quote marks are possible. Left out: the 'other types of leave' sections, and the gross-earnings, ACC and payment-scenario parts of the holiday pay page. Many link words did not come through and are marked [link words missing]; in the cash-up page several key words are missing ('can ask their [ ] to [ ] up to 1 week', 'up to $10,000 per [ ]'). Oddities on the pages themselves: the employer page lists 'cancel annual holidays that have already been approved, if you have a good reason' as something an employer can do, but both pages also say neither side has to agree to cancel; the employee page says the employer cannot make you take holidays in advance, while the employer page adds 'except when there is an annual closedown'; the employee page says the employer can refuse advance holidays, the employer page says only unless the employment agreement has a relevant clause; 'Good reason' appears only as a link with no explanation; the closedown example titled 'Employer does not agree to employee taking annual holidays in advance' is in fact a partial agreement (1 week of 2); the Vinh cancelling story has no ending; one sentence reads 'if they leave your employment before, they become entitled' (stray comma); the Managing page is older (November 2025) than the others. The pages do not say what an employee should do if a request gets no answer, or how far ahead to ask.
status: Reviewer: 5 instructions missed (incl. employer cash-up limits), 17 findings, all fixed. 158 of 158 quotes exact (web copy).
